title: Protect your small business from common cyber security risks
summary: This page provides small businesses with information on common cyber security risks and how to protect themselves.

faqs.q: What are some common cyber security risks for small businesses?
faqs.a: Common risks include phishing, ransomware, and weak passwords. Businesses should also be aware of risks related to physical security and employee training.

faqs.q: How can I protect my business from cyber attacks?
faqs.a: Protecting your business involves implementing strong passwords, regularly updating software, training employees, and having a backup plan.

faqs.q: Where can I find more resources on cyber security?
faqs.a: You can find online resources through Service NSW Business Bureau or consult the Australian Cyber Security Centre for detailed guidance.
